How to Play

Setup

Shuffle the deck. Each player starts with 7 Gold Coins. The last coin sits in the center — the Chest. Both players draw a card; the higher card wins that coin and takes the first turn.

Each Round

Both players draw a card face down and place 1 Gold Coin into the Chest.

Hold Fast — keep your face-down card without looking. No extra coin.

Peek — add 1 coin to the Chest to look at your card.

If you Peek, you may also Press Your Luck — pay 1 more coin to draw a second card.

Resolving the Round

Both players reveal. The highest total of 5 or lower wins. Going over 5 is an automatic loss. A tie starts a new round with the coins remaining in the Chest.

Death Cards

Revealing a Death Card is an automatic round win. If both players reveal a Death Card, it's a draw. If both reveal a Death Card alongside a number card, the higher number wins. Revealing two Death Cards wins the game instantly.

Winning

First player to claim all 15 Gold Coins wins the game.

Player 2 Takes the Table

Fifteen coins, gone.
